name: Artemis Eccho and the Subliminal Labyrinth
source:
After an urban exploration escapade goes terribly wrong, Artemis Eccho and her four best friends find themselves lost in the mundane, repeating halls of another world! 

[From [url=https://wohmallow.itch.io/artemis-eccho-and-the-subliminal-labyrinth]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场城市废墟探险意外酿成大祸后，阿耳忒弥斯·埃科与她的四位死党发现自己迷失在了异世界平淡无奇却无限循环的走廊之中！

[摘自[url=https://wohmallow.itch.io/artemis-eccho-and-the-subliminal-labyrinth]itch.io[/url]]
